exposure: Pediatric Support Services (PSS) Patient Navigation Program
outcome: Referral-to-service connection (specifically for mental health services)
cohort: The study included all patients referred to Pediatric Support Services (PSS), with a primary cohort analysis on a subset of patients referred specifically to mental health services.
finding: The Pediatric Support Services (PSS) program successfully triaged over 13,000 referrals, connected 50.6% of mental health patients to services with an additional 27.1% having pending appointments, and achieved high caregiver satisfaction.
